summary: Quiet residential kerb; best at bushy south end, homes within 25m behind.
reasons: Tree-covered both sides at south end
Homes 19-22m away just north of it

drivers.seclusion: Trees and bush on both sides at 108-130 m; nearest dwellings 19-22m back at about 98-104 m, then 50m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along it; room to pull in on the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, a junction with a larger road at the south end.
drivers.convention: No signs; cars park along the street, but no camping convention.

flags: Steep: about 5% grade here, 9.7% over the whole stretch
Low-lying: about 4-5 m elevation, creek 28 m away
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from both sides, little direct sun.
cannot_judge: Whether parking is allowed right at the junction

best_section.where: West kerb of Kate Street, bushy stretch just before the southern junction
